train_ml_ar_model: train a MLARModel on a list of TimeSeriesData objects using MLARParams configuration
predict_ml_ar_forecasts: predict multi-step forecasts from a trained MLARModel with optional new data
create_ml_ar_params: create MLARParams to configure horizon, input_window, and LightGBM hyperparameters for the model
normalize_time_series_data: normalize a pandas DataFrame row-wise using a normalizer series with div or sub methods
embed_time_series_windows: embed a numpy array into sliding window features with specified lags and horizon
